stageBMatrix.taskTitle: Core Canonicalization Engine & Statutory Boundary Conflict Resolution

criteria.evaluation: Migration 059 canonical constituency registry, conflict resolution infrastructure, unique indexes, and foreign keys verified on disk.
National constituency canonicalization specification report verified covering all 4,123 statutory Assembly Constituencies.
Migration 060 geography remediation schema, temporal constraints, and delimitation regime catalogs verified.
Migration 061 AC-to-PC mapping registry verified with exactly 4,123 mapping rows, zero orphaned ACs, zero orphaned PCs, and uniform state partition invariants.
Migration 062 Assam delimitation schema verified with 126 new 2023 AC versions, 14 2023 PC versions, Table B mapping, and statutory reservations.
Assam 2023 delimitation reconciliation report verified with temporal cutoff simulation and preservation of historical 2008 boundaries.

stageBMatrix.taskTitle: National Assembly Boundary GeoJSON Deep Validation & Linkage

criteria.evaluation: Telangana assembly GeoJSON deep RFC 7946 validation passed with Indian bounding box; AC 119 duplicate claim defect detected and confirmed.
National statutory boundary completeness across 31 States/UTs blocked pending 30 remaining state authoritative GeoJSON feeds and official CEO Telangana AC 119 defect resolution.
